title: Failover-test: Nomad leader
description: Same shape as DEMO-03 but against Nomad's Raft cluster (port 4646, systemctl nomad). SSHs into the current Nomad leader, stops `nomad.service`, measures Raft re-election RTO, auto-recovers.

observe.what: scenario tag · original leader · new leader · RTO seconds · recovery state · timeline
Servers tab briefly shows the killed node leaving and rejoining the raft

whatProves: Nomad's Raft re-elects under load; the CLI's failover-test family scales from Consul to Nomad with the same RTO-timeline shape (observed ~2.716s in 0.3.1).
